scripts.start: docker compose up -d postgres && concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan.bgGray,green.bgGray --prefix "[{name}:{pid}]" "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.check: biome check backend/src backend/test frontend/src frontend/*.ts frontend/*.mts frontend/*.mjs
scripts.format: biome format --write backend/src backend/test frontend/src frontend/*.ts frontend/*.mts frontend/*.mjs
scripts.lint: biome lint backend/src backend/test frontend/src frontend/*.ts frontend/*.mts frontend/*.mjs
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
